withdrawal_reason: This amendment incorrectly generalized failure of one six-feature stochastic response-winner classifier into rejection of RS expansion, treated historical synthetic MP/MS/ME proxy diagnostics as formal component experiments, and changed the estimand to retrieve-then-admit without authorization. It is retained only as an auditable failed decision.
supersedes: G3/G4 state-level stochastic response-winner training route
any pending RS expansion or additional RS human annotation
does_not_supersede: separate quality, atomic risk, and deterministic cost reporting
revised_research_question: Can a low-capacity, default-off retrieve-then-admit policy learn out-of-user signal for injecting at least one fixed memory component candidate, while preserving immediate support quality and prespecified interaction-and-grounding risk proxies and reducing generator prompt resources relative to a high-resource fixed policy?

sequence: at most one injected item per admitted source
revised_decision_boundary.resource_on_definition: At least one candidate item from that component enters the generator prompt.

training_targets.primary_definition: Relevant, nonredundant, current, nonconflicting evidence that may enter the response prompt.
training_targets.response_outcome_role: Qualify the treatment and evaluate the final policy; do not treat one stochastic response winner as a per-state oracle.

model_order: BAAI item-level feature only if it improves grouped admission or retrieval evidence

external_roles.ESConv: single-session resource-off/abstention and fixed RS diagnostic; not memory-on evidence
external_roles.EvoEmo_or_ES_MemEval_derived: development-informed ME transport and stale/conflict stress test

next: balance construction metadata and run shortcut gate before fitting
run only learned, always-off, and high-resource fixed end-to-end conditions

human_annotation_policy.next_allowed_human_packet: one final compact 24-32 state end-to-end policy comparison only
human_annotation_policy.risk_if_event_count_is_small: report descriptively; do not expand indefinitely to manufacture a trainable risk head
